description: Asks before a subagent touches a resource its OpenCode rules ask about; Claude Code ignores subagent hooks of plugins.

hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/agent-guard.mjs"; I=$(cat); X=; if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then X=node; elif command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then X=bun; fi; if [ -n "$X" ] && O=$(printf '%s' "$I" | "$X" "$R") && [ -n "$O" ]; then printf '%s' "$O"; else if printf '%s' "$I" | grep -Eq '"agent_type"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*:)?(code-reviewer)"'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"agent guard could not run; denying instead"}}'; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"agent guard could not run; asking instead"}}'; fi; fi; exit 0
